FirewallDefaultsModel.description:
Model for a default firewall rule (direction, permission, comment).

Used to set baseline allow/deny behavior for inbound/outbound traffic.

direction.description: Direction of traffic for the default rule: 'in' or 'out'.

permission.description: Permission for the default rule: 'allow' or 'deny'.

comment.description: Optional comment or documentation for the default rule.

FirewallDirection.description: Firewall rule direction: inbound (in) or outbound (out).

FirewallMetaModel.description: Firewall metadata including name, annotations, labels, and tags.

name.description: Unique name for the firewall resource

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the firewall resource

FirewallPermission.description: Firewall rule permission: allow or deny.

FirewallProtocol.description: Firewall rule protocol: tcp, udp, or icmp.

FirewallRuleModel.description:
One firewall rule: `direction`, and optionally `proto`, `port`, `interface`, `from`, `to` and a `comment`. `from` and `to` are a literal IP or CIDR, or a string with value tokens such as `${var:KEY}`, `${secret:KEY}` or `${feature:KEY}`.

Rules:
- `proto` is required when `port` is set.
- An `icmp` rule cannot set `port`.

name.description: Optional rule identifier, unique within the ruleset (across `allow` and `deny`) when set. Most clouds require one, for example Azure NSG and GCP firewall rules.

priority.description: Optional evaluation order, lower first, as in Azure NSG and GCP firewall rules. AWS security groups have no such concept. It does not guarantee precedence over a cloud's own reserved default rules, so pick a value that is safe for your provider.

direction.description: Direction of traffic: 'in' for inbound, 'out' for outbound.

proto.description: Protocol for the rule: 'tcp', 'udp', or 'icmp'. Optional.

port.description: Single port (int), port range (str like '80:90'), or list of ports/ranges. Optional.

from.description: Source IP or CIDR (for inbound rules): literal, or a string containing '${var:KEY}'/'${secret:KEY}'/'${feature:KEY}' tokens. Optional.

to.description: Destination IP or CIDR (for outbound rules): literal, or a string containing '${var:KEY}'/'${secret:KEY}'/'${feature:KEY}' tokens. Optional.

comment.description: Optional comment or documentation for the rule.

custom.description: Provider-specific values for this rule, for example Azure's "destination is an Application Security Group" pattern, passed to Terraform inside the rule. Strata does not validate them.

FirewallSpecModel.description:
A firewall ruleset: optional default allow or deny per direction, plus explicit `allow` and `deny` rules. A workspace uses it by listing the document in `firewalls`; a workspace resource can attach it.

Rules:
- Default rules must have unique directions: at most one for `in` and one for `out`.
- The same rule (direction, proto, port, from and to) must not appear in both `allow` and `deny`.
- Rule names, where set, must be unique across `allow` and `deny` together.

reset.description: If true, reset all existing firewall rules before applying these rules.

defaults.description: List of default rules (baseline allow/deny for each direction).

deny.description:
List of explicit deny rules.

Rules:
- `proto` is required when `port` is set.
- An `icmp` rule cannot set `port`.

allow.description:
List of explicit allow rules.

Rules:
- `proto` is required when `port` is set.
- An `icmp` rule cannot set `port`.

configuration.description: Free-form provisioner settings (for example Terraform NSG arguments strata does not model), passed to Terraform as `strata.firewalls.<name>.configuration`. Strata does not validate the keys itself: add an `attributeconfig` with `target.kind: firewall` and `target.block: configuration` to do so.

custom.description: Free-form values for your own scripts and Terraform code, passed to Terraform as `strata.firewalls.<name>.custom`. Strata does not interpret them. Validate them with an `attributeconfig` targeting `firewall` and `custom`.

default_tags.description: Baseline cloud tags for this firewall (for example `cost-center`, `environment`, `owner`), passed to Terraform as `strata.firewalls.<name>.default_tags`. Not the same as `meta.tags`, which is a free-form list for documentation. Strata does not limit the number of tags, so stay within your cloud provider's limit.

custom_tags.description: Additional cloud tags on top of `default_tags`, for one-off needs.

description: A firewall or network security group ruleset: default allow or deny per direction and explicit rules with ports, protocols and source or destination addresses. Create one per ruleset and list it in a workspace's `firewalls`.

spec.description:
Firewall specification (defaults, allow, deny rules)

Rules:
- Default rules must have unique directions: at most one for `in` and one for `out`.
- The same rule (direction, proto, port, from and to) must not appear in both `allow` and `deny`.
- Rule names, where set, must be unique across `allow` and `deny` together.
